svg.aria-label: Two-stage multi-agent workflow for pH-selective de novo EGFR binder design: Stage 1 covers epitope perception, scoring of existing EGFR data into a guidance prior, dual-route backbone generation and a five-tier candidate pool; Stage 2 covers structural gating with cross-species scoring, pH-switch design and dual-pool panel selection; a submission block lists the four priorities and the CSV fields.
svg.text: Constraints and priors that condition generation
